title: Make Reject Order reachable on inbound sales order drafts and confirm…
summary: The Reject Order action for inbound sales orders is now accessible directly from the Sales Document Draft page where sellers review incoming documents. The action also requires confirmation and displays a confirmation message to prevent accidental rejection.
key_points: Added Reject Order action to the Sales Document Draft page for inbound orders
Moved existing Reject Order action from Outgoing group to Incoming group on E-Document page
Added confirmation dialog and success message when rejecting an order
Action now surfaces the existing rejection logic to users in the workflow where they need it
quote: The Reject Order action only available on page 6121, which isn't opened for an inbound order
